integrity: The structural reduction is proved directly from the arithmetic-derivative factorization and classical divisibility argument. The asymptotic uses the prime number theorem and a self-contained weak-convergence/simplex count; finite computation is only a supplementary consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is for fixed positive integer k only; no uniform error term in growing k and no rational nonintegral level sets are treated. Literature searches cannot rule out every obscure equivalent formulation.
title: Fixed-multiplier level sets of the arithmetic derivative
